result: Cause found (B1): a library mapped into ld.so's text-to-rodata hole was attributed to ld.so because lookups matched kernel-mapped objects by whole span; fixed by matching the program and ld.so by segment run (D-27.89), layout-varying test and 4/4 plants
informational: ld.so has a 60 KiB hole between its text (ends 0x61227) and rodata (0x71000); closing it is a layout matter (LAYOUT-LDSO-*), no longer a correctness one
Start-up counts taken on the Skylake-SP class only; the start-up bin is byte-identical
